name: MCR20
tagline: Fanless Alder Lake-N network appliance with dual 10GbE and dual 2.5GbE
description: MCR20 is a compact network security and edge appliance for high-throughput routing, firewall, VPN, and gateway deployments, with flexible Intel networking and storage options.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: Intel Alder Lake-N N95, N97, N100, N200, Core i3-N300, or Core i3-N305

specifications.label: Network
specifications.value: 2 x Intel i226-V 2.5GbE plus 2 x Intel X550-T2 10GbE RJ45 or 2 x Intel 82599ES SFP+

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 2280 NVMe PCIe 3.0 x1 and 2 x SATA 3.0

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: 2 x HDMI 2.0 and 1 x Type-C, supporting 4K at 60Hz

specifications.label: USB
specifications.value: 5 x USB 2.0, 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, and 1 x Type-C USB 2.0

features.title: Multi-Gigabit Networking
features.description: Dual 2.5GbE plus dual 10GbE copper or SFP+

features.title: Alder Lake-N Platform
features.description: CPU options from N95 through Core i3-N305

features.title: Flexible Expansion
features.description: DDR5, NVMe, dual SATA, TPM, COM, TF card, and PCIe

applications.title: Complete Interface Map
applications.description: Clearly labeled front and rear connectivity

applications.title: 10GbE Security Gateway
applications.description: High-throughput routing, firewall, and VPN deployments
